Synthetic, project-authored OOXML samples for read-only preview acceptance. They contain no user data, external resources, macros or credentials. sample.docx contains text and a table; sample.pptx has two slides; sample.xlsx has two worksheets and a formula. Created with python-docx 1.2.0, python-pptx 1.0.2 and openpyxl 3.1.5; those tools are not runtime dependencies.

`sample.doc` is a project-authored minimal Word 97 CFB binary with an uncompressed Unicode piece table, four paragraphs and Chinese/English text. It verifies actual legacy parsing, not a renamed DOCX or a complex-layout corpus.
